run_forward_fastlin_bound_propagation: run forward linear bound propagation using the FastLin relaxation method on a neural network function
run_forward_crown_bound_propagation: run forward linear bound propagation using the CROWN relaxation method on a neural network function
run_ibpforwardfastlin_bound_propagation: run bound propagation combining IBP and FastLin to obtain tighter output bounds
build_linear_bound: build a LinearBound object representing linear bounds over neural network activations
create_linear_function: create a LinearFunction object representing lower and upper linear bounds with a reference bound
